name: Brother Wilhelm
summary: Behind Goldshire's smithy, Brother Wilhelm guides young paladins into the wider forest. They come from Northshire Abbey to take their first steps in Elwynn.

sections.title: A Guide in Goldshire
sections.body: Brother Wilhelm trains new paladins behind Goldshire's smithy. Northshire Valley shelters those who begin their path in the Light, but many seek his guidance once they enter the wider forest. He teaches them their sacred duties as they leave the abbey. Then they take up the work of protecting the realm.

sections.title: The Path of the Tome
sections.body: Brother Wilhelm guides aspiring paladins toward the Tome of Divinity. Its rite teaches initiates the weight of sacrifice and the power of divine redemption. Through the trials, they test their devotion and learn to wield the Light. They can resurrect fallen comrades and uphold justice across the Kingdom of Stormwind.

faq.q: Where can I find Brother Wilhelm?
faq.answer: Brother Wilhelm is behind the village blacksmith's workshop in Goldshire, Elwynn Forest. He trains and guides aspiring paladins there.

faq.q: What services does Brother Wilhelm provide?
faq.answer: Brother Wilhelm teaches young paladins new spells, martial blessings, and holy techniques as they travel through Elwynn Forest.

faq.q: Is Brother Wilhelm part of the Brotherhood of Northshire?
faq.answer: Brother Wilhelm's title and closeness to Northshire Abbey suggest ties to the Brotherhood of Northshire. From Goldshire, he serves the Church of the Holy Light and the Kingdom of Stormwind.

faq.q: What is his role in the Tome of Divinity quest?
faq.answer: Brother Wilhelm guides human paladins who have grown in power toward the Tome of Divinity and its trials. Those trials lead to the sacred blessing of resurrection.

angles.text: As a paladin, you find your first mentor in Brother Wilhelm after leaving Northshire Valley. He guides your growth and opens the path to mastering the Tome of Divinity.
As a human, you see in Brother Wilhelm the faith of the Church of the Holy Light, which defends Elwynn's heartland.
